purpose: Controlled planning reasoning-effort comparison. First8 high-effort results contained7 truncated completions, includingN08. No evaluation label or failure text enters either request.

constructor_policy.candidates: Union of exact public-issue token names, complete original anchor callee names, and syntactically public type/field/global declarations.
constructor_policy.public: Go exported identifiers; Python non-underscore names; TypeScript explicitly exported types/globals and public fields of explicitly exported owners. Naming is not a complete export or API visibility proof.
constructor_policy.order: Issue first occurrence/path/start; then original anchor index/callee byte/path/start; then public declarations path/start. Keep whole entries or record omission.
constructor_policy.selection: At most twelve ordered unique shown declaration IDs; no source text, paths, offsets, code or validity judgment from the model.
constructor_policy.evidence: Complete contiguous adjacent documentation and source header. One exact lexical class or same-package declared Go receiver type documentation layer; no member expansion.
constructor_policy.budget: 64KB directory and96KB complete planning prompt. Selected complete evidence groups fit24KB and the complete inherited generation prompt fits96KB. Never truncate source or drop an inherited anchor.
constructor_policy.fallback: Unknown, incomplete, malformed or empty plan, or zero admitted evidence groups, retains the original R18 catalog. Preserve planning status and costs.
constructor_policy.semantics: Declaration ownership and names are retrieval context, not actual callee binding, contract entailment or oracle validity.
constructor_policy.forbidden: No model-generated tests, native outcomes, evaluation labels, reference implementations or historical audit decisions are inputs.
